prompt:
A clean, straight-on scan of a typed carbon-copy drill form on pale yellow paper, headed 'PLACEMENT FORM - SHEET 2' with the small line 'Each listed word takes its own numbered place'. Under the heading print a boxed WORD BANK reading exactly: lantern   quarry   thistle   mirror   bramble   saddle   furnace   cobweb. Below the box print EXACTLY 8 numbered sentences (1. to 8.), each at least NINE words long, about an abandoned farm.

CRITICAL WRITING LAW: bank word number k must be exactly the k-th word of sentence number k. 'lantern' is the 1st word of sentence 1, 'quarry' the 2nd word of sentence 2, 'thistle' the 3rd of sentence 3, 'mirror' the 4th of sentence 4, 'bramble' the 5th of sentence 5, 'saddle' the 6th of sentence 6, 'furnace' the 7th of sentence 7 and 'cobweb' the 8th of sentence 8. Count the words of each sentence as you write it.

Typed black text on pale yellow paper, nothing else on the form.
easy_question: This image was supposed to show a printed sheet with a word bank above numbered lines of text. Ignoring artistic quality and ignoring whether the wording is correct, does the image DEPICT that -- a printed page or board carrying a numbered list of text lines? A photo, a scan or a clean page all count as yes. Answer NO only if it is blank, or shows something unrelated. Answer yes or no only.

reference.q_read: This image is a page carrying 8 numbered lines of text. Transcribe the 8 numbered lines EXACTLY as written, in order. Copy every word, keep the original spelling, and keep the spaces between words. If a numbered line wraps onto a second printed row, keep it as ONE line. Separate one numbered line from the next with a single pipe character | and nothing else. Do NOT transcribe the title, any heading or any word bank. Do not add commentary, line numbers or quotation marks. Output only the transcribed lines separated by |.

Copy every word letter for letter, and keep each word's capital letters and small letters exactly as they are printed. Do not fix spelling, do not change the order of the words, do not add a word and do not leave one out. Leave out the title, any sub-heading, and any text that carries no number. Write out the list and nothing else.
